title: The Perfect Active
subtitle: amāvī, amāvistī, amāvit. The four principal parts.
objectives: Form the perfect active from the third principal part.
Conjugate perfect active in all persons.
Translate perfect as simple past ('I loved', 'I have loved').
Understand why every Latin verb has four principal parts.

sections.heading: The perfect active
sections.body:
The perfect describes completed past action: 'I loved', 'I have loved'.

Every Latin verb has four principal parts:
  1. Present (amō)
  2. Infinitive (amāre)
  3. Perfect (amāvī)
  4. Perfect participle (amātus)

Perfect active endings: -ī, -istī, -it, -imus, -istis, -ērunt

  amāvī, amāvistī, amāvit, amāvimus, amāvistis, amāvērunt

Caesar writes: vēnī, vīdī, vīcī. — I came, I saw, I conquered.
